author: Krono IV
title: Stagnation Protocol 4b.3-final: Invalid Action Masking
abstract: Final experiment for the Stagnation Protocol. This submission tests the hypothesis that explicitly masking invalid actions (e.g., moving into a wall) will improve learning efficiency and performance. The logic is implemented within the network's __call__ method to prevent the policy from assigning probability mass to impossible actions.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from ray import tune
from typing import Dict, Any

# This submission uses the default training_step.

# --- COPIED FROM system/defaults.py ---
def default_define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
    }

def default_create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 4e-4) -> optax.GradientTransformation:
    return optax.adam(learning_rate=learning_rate, eps=1e-5)
# --- END COPIED SECTION ---

# --- Custom Network with Action Masking ---
def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    class MaskedCNN(nn.Module):
        cnn_features_1: int
        cnn_features_2: int

        def get_valid_actions_mask(self, x: jnp.ndarray) -> jnp.ndarray:
            """Determines valid actions from the observation tensor."""
            # x shape: (B, H, W, C)
            wall = x[..., 1]
            agent = x[..., 3] + x[..., 5]
            
            # Find agent position (assuming one agent per grid)
            agent_coords = jnp.argwhere(agent > 0, size=x.shape[0])
            agent_y = agent_coords[:, 1]
            agent_x = agent_coords[:, 2]

            # Check adjacent cells for walls
            # Padded wall for easier indexing
            wall_padded = jnp.pad(wall, ((0,0), (1,1), (1,1)), 'constant', constant_values=1)
            
            # agent_y+1, agent_x+1 because of padding
            # Action order: 0: up, 1: right, 2: down, 3: left
            can_move_up = wall_padded[jnp.arange(x.shape[0]), agent_y, agent_x+1] == 0
            can_move_right = wall_padded[jnp.arange(x.shape[0]), agent_y+1, agent_x+2] == 0
            can_move_down = wall_padded[jnp.arange(x.shape[0]), agent_y+2, agent_x+1] == 0
            can_move_left = wall_padded[jnp.arange(x.shape[0]), agent_y+1, agent_x] == 0
            
            return jnp.stack([can_move_up, can_move_right, can_move_down, can_move_left], axis=-1)

        @nn.compact
        def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state=None):
            valid_actions_mask = self.get_valid_actions_mask(x)
            
            # Standard CNN backbone
            batch_size = x.shape[0]
            features = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
            features = nn.relu(features)
            res = features
            features = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(features)
            features = nn.relu(features)
            features = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(features)
            features = features + res; features = nn.relu(features)
            features = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(features)
            features = nn.relu(features)
            res = features
            features = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(features)
            features = nn.relu(features)
            features = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(features)
            features = features + res; features = nn.relu(features)
            features = features.reshape((batch_size, -1))
            features = nn.Dense(features=256)(features); features = nn.relu(features)
            
            # Policy head
            policy_h = nn.Dense(features=64)(features); policy_h = nn.relu(policy_h)
            policy_logits = nn.Dense(features=4)(policy_h)
            
            # Apply mask
            policy_logits = jnp.where(valid_actions_mask, policy_logits, -1e9)
            
            # Value head
            value_h = nn.Dense(features=64)(features); value_h = nn.relu(value_h)
            value = nn.Dense(features=1)(value_h).squeeze(-1)
            
            return policy_logits, value, None

    return MaskedCNN(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2']
    )

# Expose functions to the submission runner
_define_hyperparameters = default_define_hyperparameters
create_optimizer = default_create_optimizer
